newsitem.title: USA: Zmax unit says gets contract with WP&L.
newsitem.headline: Zmax unit says gets contract with WP&L.

text.p: Zmax Corp said Wednesday its wholly owned subsidiary Century Services Inc has signed and begun work on a contract to provide a year 2000 conversion solution for Wisconsin Power & Light Co .
The company declined to disclose the value of the contract.
The company said it will apply all phases of its service in this project, including inventory analysis, impact assessment, conversion, testing, and implementation.
Zmax's stock was trading at around 14 5/8. It closed yesterday at 13 and 15/16.
